supersedes_interpretation: Do not require the proof arm to reconstruct the internal PrefixGraph winner on controls where completed G0-G4 already wins.
reason: The proposed terminal is a cross-representation publication proof. Current selection publishes PrefixGraph only when exact pg_bytes < complete g04_bytes. A candidate whose sound lower bound reaches complete G0-G4 bytes cannot publish; determining which losing PrefixGraph candidate would have won the internal PrefixGraph-only tournament is unnecessary work.
required_reference: Process-build unchanged canonical-private PrefixGraph once on every control as the full reference and retain its exact bytes, SHA-256, anchor, locality and strong-verification evidence.
g04_winner_controls: The proof arm must preserve final inner selection as G0-G4 and may terminate all provably non-publishable PrefixGraph candidates. It need not reconstruct a losing internal PrefixGraph-only winner.
prefixgraph_winner_controls: The true process-built PrefixGraph winning anchor must remain live, and the surviving proof tournament must exactly reproduce its bytes, SHA-256, anchor and locality.
claim_boundary: Evidence-specification correction only. No product bytes, runtime, RSS, reader, grammar, release gate or release authority changes.
